name: ppt-anything
description: Zero-config slide decks by image generation, driven by Codex. Build, preview, edit, research and export decks without leaving the editor.

interface.shortDescription: Make slide decks by image generation, inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: PPT Anything turns a prompt into a slide deck where every slide is an image drawn by Codex — no API key. From Codex you can create a deck (optionally deep-research-backed), open a live preview in the in-editor browser, regenerate or mark-edit slides, and export to PDF/PPTX.
defaultPrompt: Make a 6-slide deck about our Q3 roadmap and open the preview.
Deep-research the 2026 humanoid robot market, then build a deck from it.
Regenerate slide 3 of my latest deck to be warmer.
